about_the_game:
Allows you to use Firion and equip him with the following items.
- Committed to the Cause I (Appearance)
- Committed to the Cause II (Appearance)
- Committed to the Cause III (Appearance)
- Arsenal I (Weapon)
- Arsenal II (Weapon)
- Arsenal III (Weapon)
- Special Chat Messages

*You must first download DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT Free Edition before you can use this content.
